notes.title: Demo update 0.2.6
notes.notes:
Updated the game to version 0.2.6

Added options to invert the Y and X axis

Fixed an issue where you couldn’t navigate the options menu with a controller unless you used a mouse first

Added shadow quality option to settings

Minor gameplay tweak

notes.title: Demo update 0.2.5
notes.notes:
Updated Demo build to 0.2.5

Made the glow-rod movement a little more dynamic. Reacts to jumping now etc.

Moved the FOV slider into display settings. I don’t know why I had it in controls.

Added a setting to turn tutorial messages off or on.

If tutorials are on, the first chase will prompt the player to run.

The monster’s footsteps are also louder in the chase.

Added a new item to the Security level as a tease.

Slightly changed inventory art for improved powercells.

Added a button to the main menu that links to the presskit.

Footsteps are now louder when landing after jumping/falling instead of sometimes being very quiet even after a long fall.

notes.title: Demo update 0.2.4
notes.notes:
Updated the game to version 0.2.4

This update improves the general atmosphere across most of the game, and is the first in a series of planned improvements to the demo.

-Big light changes, a few areas completely re-done.

-Includes some new props for more varied lighting fixtures.

-New audio system added to some areas.

-Fixed a light that was only visible with lumen off.

-Minor changes to the sounds the first monster makes when spawning.

-Tweaked LOD settings on some props.
